title: Rita R Possible NDE 8949
content: I had a heart attack when I was 19 years old. I heard bells and someone was singing in the Sydney Opera that day. They asked me if I wanted a family because that would change my life. I told them that I wanted a family and I love my children dearly since this experience. I received knowledge. I flew in outer space, until I reached Jupiter. I was expanded and I was huge. My guides told me how planets were formed. Everything was discussed with me. I was sent back to my body. I came back crying, I had to take on a difficult life. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: May 1992 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes CPR given Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) I could hear heart rate monitors, but my monitor was silent. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I heard the noon bell ringing and someone singing opera aria. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal My senses were heightened, it felt like I was in a state of infinity. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I don't understand the question Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I couldn’t estimate how long it lasted. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I wore glasses during the experience and I still wear them. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't remember Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I heard the voice of my great-grandfather. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain I can’t remember Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was next to the planet Jupiter, stopped there, and came back. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Happiness. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe I knew everything about the Earth and how the planets formed. Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future Everything was told to me and I had to cry. Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Jehovahs Witness My landlord brought me to his Jehovah’s witness church. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Can’t be explained Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I decided to accept family. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify. A man was talking to me. My future children introduced themselves to me. They said they will love me and they will be my family. They are holy people. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes We are born on a vertica; generation lineage line. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes Our own heart is like the reflection of God. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes I understood that family is important. Also, we should multiply in harmony with Earth’s nature. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife probably exists Our consciousness dissolves, happens somewhere. Maybe near the Earth? Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes. I would have a difficult life. During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes The love is reflected and we sense it as light. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I can’t speak up, gossip will not leave my mouth, and I don’t have any bad feelings. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I thought no one would believe me. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience less accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Many years have passed since then. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I have became more sensible. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I tried to tell this, because this experience is impossible to forget. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain I’ve read some books. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real When I remember it, I accept it as part of my life. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely not real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: Future children introduced themselves to her; she also heard an unidentified man's voice; she heard the voice of her great-grandfather; she refers to 'my guides'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Flew in outer space until reaching Jupiter; was next to Jupiter, stopped there, and came back; felt expanded/huge; sensed a mystical light.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She was told/learned she would have a difficult life; also discussed choosing to have a family ('they asked me if I wanted a family').

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Jehovah's Witness (prior); Christian - Other Christian (current, 'can't be explained')

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Travel in outer space to Jupiter; future children introduced themselves; heard bells and opera singing; received knowledge about planet formation.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with hearing earthly sounds, then space travel/knowledge exchange, barrier/return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heard noon bell and opera aria during separation; traveled through outer space to Jupiter; felt expanded/huge; future children introduced themselves; 'born on a vertica; generation lineage line'; 'Our own heart is like the reflection of God.'
